name: Shuppim
overview: The name Shuppim appears in Scripture as a descendant of Ir, highlighting his place within a specific family lineage (1 Chronicles 7:12). Shuppim is also connected through marriage, as seen in the account where Machir marries the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, indicating familial ties that extend into the broader tribal relationships (1 Chronicles 7:15). Additionally, Shuppim is associated with a Levitical role or territorial responsibility, receiving a westward lot near the gate Shallecheth, which reflects a position of stewardship or service within the community (1 Chronicles 26:16). Together, these references show Shuppim as both a family figure and a participant in the organized life of Israel.
